instruction: words.txt holds one lowercase word per line. Write groups.py printing each anagram group with 2+ members as the members joined by '.' (members sorted alphabetically), one group per line, groups sorted by first member. Run it.

grader.script:
python3 groups.py > got.txt && printf 'enlist.listen.silent
evil.veil.vile
night.thing
' | diff - got.txt

oracle.script:
cat > groups.py <<'EOF'
from collections import defaultdict
groups = defaultdict(list)
for w in open('words.txt').read().split():
    groups[''.join(sorted(w))].append(w)
out = ['.'.join(sorted(g)) for g in groups.values() if len(g) > 1]
out.sort(key=lambda s: s.split('.')[0])
print('\n'.join(out))
EOF
python3 groups.py
